date_eligibility.factor_warmup_start: first joint trading date on which at least one PIT-eligible security has a finite factor value
date_eligibility.primary_outcome_availability: D+10 target date exists in frozen joint calendar and is <= pinned source max_bar_date
date_eligibility.eligible_dates: every joint A-share trading date from factor_warmup_start through the last primary-outcome-available date, bounded by stage1_max_signal_date
date_eligibility.valid_evaluation_date: factor finite coverage / official PIT universe count >=0.70 and D+10 Rank-IC is computable

cross_section.spearman: Pearson correlation of within-date average ranks of factor and forward return after dropping rows missing either value
cross_section.quintiles: within-date average factor rank percentile; quintile = ceil(percentile*5), clipped to 1..5
cross_section.raw_spread: Q5 mean D+10 return minus Q1 mean D+10 return
cross_section.broad_a_equal_weight: mean D+10 economic return of all PIT-eligible rows with available D and T endpoints on the signal date
cross_section.csi300: 000300.SS from pinned dojo_benchmark_kline when both D and T endpoints are present

bootstrap.one_sided_null_p: center direction-adjusted series by subtracting observed mean; p=(1+count(null_bootstrap_mean>=observed_mean))/(B+1)

holm_bonferroni.implementation: sort nine one-sided D+10 Rank-IC p-values ascending; reject sequentially at alpha/(m-i) until first failure; all subsequent hypotheses fail multiplicity gate

quarter_stability.quarter_direction_requirement: positive direction-adjusted mean D+10 IC in at least 2/3 of valid quarters
quarter_stability.leave_one_valid_quarter_out: for every valid quarter q, mean direction-adjusted D+10 IC over all valid dates not in q must be >0

canonical_panel_hash.storage_format: Parquet ZSTD, pyarrow major version pinned by workflow
canonical_panel_hash.note: Panel bytes are ephemeral/reproducible; SHA256, row count, source hashes and builder code are frozen.
